overview_description.description:
Beamery is the AI platform for workforce transformation: We are trusted by global enterprises to plan, build, and optimize their future of work.

By connecting skills and task intelligence to real-time workforce data, Beamery’s agentic talent advisor enables businesses to hire, redeploy, and reskill talent – and adapt to change with confidence.

We’re on a mission to create a world where employee skills and contributions are seen and understood, access to opportunity is equitable, and every organization can responsibly unlock the full potential of its workforce with AI.

about_short_description.short_description: Beamery provides an AI-based talent lifecycle management platform for workforce planning and recruitment.

product.name: Workforce Insights
product.description: Provides dynamic insights into the supply and demand of skills to understand current talent and identify gaps for workforce planning and risk management.

product.name: Talent Acquisition
product.description: Uses AI and skills data to find, engage, and hire candidates faster by matching talent to roles based on skills and potential.

product.name: Talent Experience
product.description: Delivers personalized candidate engagement through portals, career sites, chatbots, and event management to improve recruitment and retention.

product.name: Skills Gap Analysis Software
product.description: Analyzes workforce skills to identify shortages and align talent strategies with business needs using AI-driven insights.

product.name: AI in HR
product.description: Provides AI-driven tools to augment HR workflows, reduce bias, and improve talent matching based on skills and potential.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: Connects Beamery’s platform with HR systems like Workday and SAP to enhance data and skills intelligence across the talent lifecycle.
